result.reasoning: This commit ("ND2: parse true Y and Z physical sizes") introduced the metadata text-parsing loop `while (!key.endsWith(":") && key.indexOf("_") < 0)` that builds up a multi-token key by splitting on spaces. This is the exact logic that was later mechanically converted to StringBuffer form (commit b48fd4a88c599647535f6943a8a62b3d77c1d6e5, a Findbugs refactor with no semantic change) which produced `sb.charAt(sb.length()-1) != ':'`. The underlying bug — calling a length/char-at-last-position check on a potentially empty string/StringBuffer — originates in this original commit that introduced the parsing loop, since `lines[i]` could be an empty string (e.g., from consecutive spaces), causing `key.charAt(key.length()-1)`/`endsWith` equivalent logic to fail on an empty string. The fix commit's guard `sb.length() == 0 ||` directly patches this scenario, which was possible from the very introduction of this loop.
